  "rationale": "The shortfall to the 0.8811 bar is 0.0143, and cut_headroom on the best attempt is only 0.0073 — a perfect cut buys at most half of it, so the remaining distance is on the ranking axis, not the operating point (and moving scale_pos_weight further out is ruled out anyway: recall 0.8752 already exceeds specificity 0.8583 at 10.0, while at 8.0 the inequality was reversed, so the optimum is bracketed inside).
